Either ensure experiment nginx.conf is the only loaded config (nginx -c) and cache directory exists with correct permissions, or disable proxy_cache for health gate validation phase.

Verify health gate passes before proceeding to measurement phases: the experiment correctly aborted at health gate but the root cause is infrastructure (nginx cache permissions), not the scientific harness.

validity_findings: HEALTH_GATE_FAILED is an infrastructure/nginx configuration failure, not a scientific falsification. The producer correctly classified status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID and outcome=INCONCLUSIVE per EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md §9.
Flask listening verification (V-FLASK-LISTENING) passed: socket connect to 127.0.0.1:19860 succeeded before nginx start, confirming factory-pattern WSGI and sys.path fix work.
nginx config syntax (V-NGINX-CONFIG-OK) passed: nginx -t validated the experiment's nginx.conf with proxy_pass without trailing slash, add_header X-Worker-Pid always, and $request_uri sticky hash.

The nginx proxy cache permission error (/var/lib/nginx/proxy/) indicates the system nginx default config may be loaded alongside or instead of the experiment config, or the cache directory permissions are incorrect. This is a substrate/environment issue.

No experimental data was collected: n_observations=0, raw_freshness_observations.jsonl empty, all C1-C5 metrics are zeros/defaults. The reported HIT 330/330 appears to be an in-memory decompression test (no HTTP), not a measured HTTP HIT via nginx cache.

Honest-cost metrics (C3) and full-vector metrics (C4) are computed on synthetic/generated data (rng.randint, rng.random) not real HTTP trajectories because health gate failed before Phase 1 data collection. These are not valid measurements of the target system.
Header-only Jaccard orthogonality (C2) computed on empty freshness_records (slice [:800] of empty list), yielding r=0, V=0 vacuously. Not a valid test of de-confounding.

Full-vector discrimination (C4) probes run against direct Flask port 19860 in Phase 4, but these ran after health gate failure was already recorded and processes killed. The code structure suggests Phase 4-5 would not execute after early return at line 490-491.
